# Agent Card Template (Tiger Team Standard)

Use this one-page template for every candidate agent in the catalog.

## Document Metadata

- Agent name:
- Version:
- Date:
- Owner:
- Reviewer(s):
- Status: `Concept` | `Pilot` | `Scale` | `Hold`

## 1) Purpose

- Problem statement:
- Why now:
- Primary user personas:
- Workflow scope boundaries (in scope / out of scope):

## 2) Integrations

- Required systems:
- Integration mode per system: `Read` | `Write` | `Event` | `Bi-directional`
- API readiness status:
- Access/security dependencies:
- Blockers and owner:

## 3) Expected Human Input and Controls

- Human roles involved:
- Required approval points:
- HITL control mode:
- Escalation path for exceptions:
- Fallback behavior if agent fails:

## 4) Expected Results

### Operational Outcomes

- Expected cycle-time impact:
- Handoff reduction target:
- Throughput impact:

### Quality Outcomes

- Accuracy target:
- Compliance/policy conformance target:
- Error/rework reduction target:

### Adoption Outcomes

- Expected adoption rate:
- Trust/satisfaction target:

## 5) KPI and ROI Metrics

### KPI Baseline and Targets

- Baseline cycle time:
- Target cycle time:
- Time saved per transaction:
- Draft acceptance rate target (if applicable):
- Action extraction accuracy target (if applicable):

### ROI Inputs

- Volume per period:
- Periods per year:
- Loaded hourly rate:
- Operating cost estimate:

### ROI Outputs

- `Annualized Hours Saved = Volume x Time Saved x Periods per Year`
- `Estimated Cost Savings = Annualized Hours Saved x Loaded Hourly Rate`
- `Net Value = Estimated Cost Savings - Operating Cost`
- Benefit confidence: `High` | `Medium` | `Low`

## 6) Stage-Gate Evidence Checklist

### Gate 1: Concept Readiness

- [ ] Purpose and scope complete
- [ ] Initial integration feasibility validated
- [ ] Initial KPI and ROI assumptions documented

### Gate 2: Pilot Readiness

- [ ] HITL/autonomy controls approved
- [ ] Security/compliance checks complete
- [ ] Baseline measurement method approved

### Gate 3: Scale Readiness

- [ ] Pilot outcomes reviewed vs targets
- [ ] Quality/trust thresholds achieved
- [ ] ROI evidence package reviewed

## 7) Pilot Plan Snapshot (If Applicable)

- Pilot start date:
- Pilot end date:
- Review cadence:
- Decision date:
- Expansion recommendation options: `Scale` | `Continue HITL` | `Hold/Redesign`

## 8) Decision Summary

- Current recommendation:
- Decision owner:
- Decision date:
- Notes:

## 9) Linked Artifacts

- Requirements reference:
- Collateral reference:
- Executive brief reference:
- Activity log entry reference:
